name: Mohammed Rahim Khan
contribution: The second Khan of the Uzbek Kungrat dynasty in the Khanate of Khiva.

checks.lead: Mohammed Rahim Khan (Turki and Persian: محمد رحیم خان; 1775–1825), was the second Khan (and fourth ruler) of the Uzbek Kungrat dynasty in the Khanate of Khiva. He reigned from 1806 to 1825.
